title: Valid Palindrome
summary: Decide whether a sentence reads the same forwards and backwards once you ignore case and punctuation.

args: A man, a plan, a canal: Panama
tests.explain: Keeping only letters and digits and lowering the case gives "amanaplanacanalpanama", which reads the same both ways.
No letters or digits remain. An empty string is a palindrome.

args: Was it a car or a cat I saw?

hints: Compare the first useful character with the last useful character, then move inward.
Use two indices, left and right. Skip any character that is not a letter or digit before comparing.
Compare lower-cased characters. If any pair differs, it isn't a palindrome; if the pointers meet, it is.

complexity.time: O(n): each index is visited once by one of the pointers
complexity.space: O(1): no cleaned copy of the string is built
